import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import pylab
from mpmath import mp, fp

EX9 = "ctx.cplot(f, points=9, axes=axes) for ctx in [mp, fp], with f(z)=z and default re=[-5,5], im=[-5,5]"
EX8 = "ctx.cplot(f, points=8, axes=axes) for ctx in [mp, fp], with f(z)=z and default re=[-5,5], im=[-5,5]"

def measure(ctx, points):
    evaluated = []
    def f(z):
        evaluated.append(z)
        return z
    fig = pylab.figure()
    ax = fig.add_subplot(111)
    ctx.cplot(f, points=points, axes=ax)
    arr = ax.images[0].get_array()
    shape = tuple(int(s) for s in arr.shape)
    pylab.close(fig)
    return len(evaluated), shape

# points=9 (the sensitive case) first, then points=8
for points in (9, 8):
    for ctx_name, ctx in (("mp", mp), ("fp", fp)):
        n, shape = measure(ctx, points)
        probe("%s points=%d len(evaluated)" % (ctx_name, points), n)
        probe("%s points=%d image.shape[0]" % (ctx_name, points), shape[0])

# the report's own examples, recorded under their exact input text
n9, _ = measure(mp, 9)
probe(EX9, n9)
n8, _ = measure(mp, 8)
probe(EX8, n8)
